en: Psalms 55
For the Chief Musician. On stringed instruments. A contemplation by David.

zh: 大衛的訓誨詩，交與伶長。用絲弦的樂器。

ja: 指揮者のために。弦楽器に合わせて。ダビデによる黙想の詩。

p.src: 1  Listen to my prayer, God. Don’t hide yourself from my supplication.

en: Listen to my prayer, God. Don’t hide yourself from my supplication.
u.src: 1  Listen to my prayer, God. Don’t hide yourself from my supplication.

p.src: 2  Attend to me, and answer me. I am restless in my complaint, and moan

ja: を顧み、答えてください。
い乱れ、 うめいている。
en: Attend to me, and answer me. I am restless in my complaint, and moan
u.src: 2  Attend to me, and answer me. I am restless in my complaint, and moan

p.src: 3  because of the voice of the enemy, because of the oppression of the wicked. For they bring suffering on me. In anger they hold a grudge against me.

ja: に恨みを抱いているからだ。
en: because of the voice of the enemy, because of the oppression of the wicked. For they bring suffering on me. In anger they hold a grudge against me.
u.src: 3  because of the voice of the enemy, because of the oppression of the wicked. For they bring suffering on me. In anger they hold a grudge against me.

p.src: 4  My heart is severely pained within me. The terrors of death have fallen on me.

en: My heart is severely pained within me. The terrors of death have fallen on me.
u.src: 4  My heart is severely pained within me. The terrors of death have fallen on me.

p.src: 5  Fearfulness and trembling have come on me. Horror has overwhelmed me.

en: Fearfulness and trembling have come on me. Horror has overwhelmed me.
u.src: 5  Fearfulness and trembling have come on me. Horror has overwhelmed me.

p.src: 6  I said, “Oh that I had wings like a dove! Then I would fly away, and be at rest.

ja: らぐことができるのに。
en: I said, “Oh that I had wings like a dove! Then I would fly away, and be at rest.
u.src: 6  I said, “Oh that I had wings like a dove! Then I would fly away, and be at rest.

p.src: 7  Behold, then I would wander far off. I would lodge in the wilderness.” Selah.

en: Behold, then I would wander far off. I would lodge in the wilderness.” Selah.
u.src: 7  Behold, then I would wander far off. I would lodge in the wilderness.” Selah.

p.src: 8  “I would hurry to a shelter from the stormy wind and storm.”

ja: は嵐の風と暴風雨を逃れ、
en: “I would hurry to a shelter from the stormy wind and storm.”
u.src: 8  “I would hurry to a shelter from the stormy wind and storm.”

p.src: 9  Confuse them, Lord, and confound their language, for I have seen violence and strife in the city.

ja: させ、その言葉を乱してください。
en: Confuse them, Lord, and confound their language, for I have seen violence and strife in the city.
u.src: 9  Confuse them, Lord, and confound their language, for I have seen violence and strife in the city.

p.src: 10  Day and night they prowl around on its walls. Malice and abuse are also within her.

en: Day and night they prowl around on its walls. Malice and abuse are also within her.
u.src: 10  Day and night they prowl around on its walls. Malice and abuse are also within her.

p.src: 11  Destructive forces are within her. Threats and lies don’t depart from her streets.

ja: にあり、 脅しと偽りはその
en: Destructive forces are within her. Threats and lies don’t depart from her streets.
u.src: 11  Destructive forces are within her. Threats and lies don’t depart from her streets.

p.src: 12  For it was not an enemy who insulted me, then I could have endured it. Neither was it he who hated me who raised himself up against me, then I would have hidden myself from him.

ja: えることができただろう。
en: For it was not an enemy who insulted me, then I could have endured it. Neither was it he who hated me who raised himself up against me, then I would have hidden myself from him.
u.src: 12  For it was not an enemy who insulted me, then I could have endured it. Neither was it he who hated me who raised himself up against me, then I would have hidden myself from him.

p.src: 13  But it was you, a man like me, my companion, and my familiar friend.

en: But it was you, a man like me, my companion, and my familiar friend.
u.src: 13  But it was you, a man like me, my companion, and my familiar friend.

p.src: 14  We took sweet fellowship together. We walked in God’s house with company.

ja: しく交わり、 人々と連れ立って
en: We took sweet fellowship together. We walked in God’s house with company.
u.src: 14  We took sweet fellowship together. We walked in God’s house with company.

p.src: 15  Let death come suddenly on them. Let them go down alive into Sheol. For wickedness is among them, in their dwelling.

en: Let death come suddenly on them. Let them go down alive into Sheol. For wickedness is among them, in their dwelling.
u.src: 15  Let death come suddenly on them. Let them go down alive into Sheol. For wickedness is among them, in their dwelling.

ja: 55:15 よみ（シェオル）は死者の場所である。
en: 55:15 Sheol is the place of the dead.

p.src: 16  As for me, I will call on God. The LORD will save me.

en: As for me, I will call on God. The LORD will save me.
u.src: 16  As for me, I will call on God. The LORD will save me.

p.src: 17  Evening, morning, and at noon, I will cry out in distress. He will hear my voice.

ja: は苦しみの中で叫ぶ。 主は
en: Evening, morning, and at noon, I will cry out in distress. He will hear my voice.
u.src: 17  Evening, morning, and at noon, I will cry out in distress. He will hear my voice.

p.src: 18  He has redeemed my soul in peace from the battle that was against me, although there are many who oppose me.

ja: に立ち向かう者が多くいるにもかかわらず。
en: He has redeemed my soul in peace from the battle that was against me, although there are many who oppose me.
u.src: 18  He has redeemed my soul in peace from the battle that was against me, although there are many who oppose me.

p.src: 19  God, who is enthroned forever, will hear and answer them. Selah. They never change and don’t fear God.

ja: 永遠に王座に着いておられる
らに答えられる。 セラ。
en: God, who is enthroned forever, will hear and answer them. Selah. They never change and don’t fear God.
u.src: 19  God, who is enthroned forever, will hear and answer them. Selah. They never change and don’t fear God.

p.src: 20  He raises his hands against his friends. He has violated his covenant.

en: He raises his hands against his friends. He has violated his covenant.
u.src: 20  He raises his hands against his friends. He has violated his covenant.

p.src: 21  His mouth was smooth as butter, but his heart was war. His words were softer than oil, yet they were drawn swords.

ja: はバターのようになめらかでしたが、
らかでしたが、 それらは
en: His mouth was smooth as butter, but his heart was war. His words were softer than oil, yet they were drawn swords.
u.src: 21  His mouth was smooth as butter, but his heart was war. His words were softer than oil, yet they were drawn swords.

p.src: 22  Cast your burden on the LORD and he will sustain you. He will never allow the righteous to be moved.

en: Cast your burden on the LORD and he will sustain you. He will never allow the righteous to be moved.
u.src: 22  Cast your burden on the LORD and he will sustain you. He will never allow the righteous to be moved.

p.src: 23  But you, God, will bring them down into the pit of destruction. Bloodthirsty and deceitful men shall not live out half their days, but I will trust in you.

ja: きることはないだろう。 しかし
en: But you, God, will bring them down into the pit of destruction. Bloodthirsty and deceitful men shall not live out half their days, but I will trust in you.
u.src: 23  But you, God, will bring them down into the pit of destruction. Bloodthirsty and deceitful men shall not live out half their days, but I will trust in you.
